title: Release Backlog
description: SSoT for work items in a release sprint. Generated by PO Agent or CSV Import Agent.

project.description: Project key prefix — used as ID prefix for all items (e.g. 'VPAT', 'CHOCO', 'AUTH'). Uppercase, 2–6 letters.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this file was generated

mode.description: hitl = pause for human approval at gates; auto = run without interruption

gates.description: Which gates to pause at (only applies when mode is 'hitl')

after_qa_write.description: Pause after QA Agent writes a failing test

after_dev_pass.description: Pause after Dev Agent makes a test pass

id.description: Unique item ID in Jira-style format: {PROJECT}-{NNN}. Single global sequence per project across all types (e.g. 'VPAT-001', 'VPAT-002'). Type is a separate field.

type.description: Item type — independent of the ID. bug = unwanted feature (same pipeline as feature).

feature.description: Feature area (maps to src/modules/{feature}/ and src/e2e/{feature}/)

currentState.description: S1 — what the app does today (before this item is implemented)

targetState.description: S2 — what the app should do after this item is complete

status.description: Lifecycle state of the item. deferred = held for a future sprint; skipped = explicitly out of scope.

testFile.description: Set by QA Agent after writing the spec (e.g. 'src/e2e/grades/grades.spec.ts')

notes.description: Optional implementation notes, edge cases, or references

sourceId.description: Original ID from external tracker (e.g. 'LIN-123', 'PROJ-456') — set by CSV Import Agent

figmaRef.description: Optional path to Figma screenshot in inputs/figma/

blockedReason.description: Required when status is 'blocked' — explains the blocker

skipReason.description: Required when status is 'deferred' or 'skipped' — explains why the item was not implemented this sprint

techDesignRef.description: References to decision IDs in metadata/tech-design.md (e.g. ['TD-001', 'TD-003'])
